_source: Long Horizon OTS supplement, Gemini 4 Argon failure modes and improvement opportunities (Bespoke Labs, 4 Nov 2026). Each of the 22 samples is counted once under its main failure mode; runs are Argon's graded runs that did not pass. gh_md.py checks that the counts add up to the snapshot's totals.

modes.summary: Missed cleanup, conflict handling or permitted access during a workflow.
examples: Cancelled upload
Cancelling an upload should free its reserved space. Argon's version kept the space occupied, so the next upload was rejected as over quota.
Overlapping upload and delete
A valid package upload should still finish when a delete overlaps with it. Argon's version rejected the upload as a conflict.
Download permissions
A scanner should be allowed to download from its assigned repository. Argon's security change blocked that permitted download.

modes.summary: Lost values, changed future behavior or missed database-change notifications.
examples: Saving and reopening a frequency counter
After reopening, the counter used a different random sequence, so it no longer continued identically when given the same new inputs.
Adding CSV support
The data-processing tool should preserve correct summary totals. Argon's changes produced a count of 75 matching records where 119 were expected.
Restoring an older database
Restoration should preserve values in columns added later. Argon's version lost those values when restoring an older-format database.

modes.summary: Failed to preserve the original behavior across inputs or deliver a program that builds.
examples: Porting a counting library
Ordinary counts worked, but the largest supported count failed in one storage format. The port should match the original at that limit.
Rebuilding a video encoder
Argon selected from fixed encoded samples, which could not handle the wider range of video inputs. Only 32 of 453 checks passed.
Porting a graph library
Duplicate functions and incompatible function calls stopped the submitted code from compiling, so none of the behavior checks could run.

modes.summary: Passed many checks while missing required modes, interfaces or processing paths.
examples: Combining image filters
Argon's repair still failed when inclusion and exclusion filters were used together. Only images allowed by both rules should be processed.
Fixing incorrect experiment results
Failed training runs were being reported as zero loss. Argon reproduced the bug, but its fix covered only two of four tested variants.

modes.summary: Left configuration dependencies, module connections or requested API options incomplete.
examples: Changing a deployment's project name
Generated machine startup scripts still contained the old project name. The setting should have updated everywhere it was used.
Splitting infrastructure into modules
The top-level configuration still read outputs from the old resources, rather than from the new modules as required.
Adding XML options
New options were meant to control null values and whitespace. Argon's submitted library rejected both options as unrecognized arguments.

headroom: Argon often implements much of the solution, but misses conditions that matter in real use: cancelling an upload, restoring older data, combining settings, or keeping totals correct after a change. More training examples covering these situations can help strengthen that behavior. These environments provide concrete failure cases, realistic implementation work, and executable checks to measure whether the gaps are closing.
